## What it is

The tower at 270°, the front. Recessed 3. Four clips on the 965.2 mm tube, including the highest. The cut end of the tube is the top clip.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side.
- The foot is the same 6.0 × 3.2 mm tab as the other towers. The 3 is recessed into the top face of the rib.
- The spoke is 4.29 mm along the tower, with a 2.15 mm 45° gusset each side at the rib. In print-up its top falls from 10 mm at the clip to 3.2 mm at the far face of the rib.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't leave the cap off. This tower's top is what the cap is there to hold at the radius.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-08: first 270° tower.
- 2026-11-08: notches and lug replaced by a recessed 3.
- 2026-11-08: spoke top slopes from the clip height down to the rib in the print-up direction.
- 2026-11-20: 26 mm pitch, 965.2 mm tube. The top clip is the cut end. Clip 10 mm, spoke 4.29 mm, gusset 2.15 mm.
